name: Breastworks
uniques: Can be built outside your borders

civilopediaText.text: Log-and-earth breastworks thrown up by infantry with axes and shovels. On the night of July 2, five New York regiments behind breastworks on Culp's Hill held off an entire Confederate division.
Infantry and Pioneers can build them anywhere in two turns.

name: Road
uniques: Can be built outside your borders

civilopediaText.text: The turnpikes and country roads that made Gettysburg a crossroads. Marching columns move three times as fast along a road, and roads bridge the creeks.

civilopediaText.text: Felling trees to open fields of fire and to build breastworks.
